name: goland-mcp-plus
description: Skills that route Go questions to the Go MCP++ tools exposed by GoLand, so answers come from the Go type system rather than from text search

interface.shortDescription: Make Codex reach for GoLand's Go tools instead of grep
interface.longDescription: The Go MCP++ GoLand plugin exposes Go navigation, interface satisfaction, refactoring and toolchain tools over the IDE's MCP server. A connected agent still reaches for grep, which in Go quietly gives wrong answers: interfaces are satisfied structurally, so nothing in the source says who implements what. These five skills route Go work to those tools instead. The MCP server itself is not bundled -- it is the IDE, on a port assigned per instance, so it is configured from Settings | Tools | MCP Server.
defaultPrompt: Which types implement this interface, and does the value type satisfy it or only the pointer?
